## Dire Bison (CR 6)

**XP** 2,400  
 N Huge animal  

**Init** +1; **Senses** low-light vision, scent; Perception +19  

**Defense**

 **AC** 18, touch 9, flat-footed 17 (+1 Dex, +9 natural, –2 size)  

**hp** 150 (10d8+70)  

**Fort** +15; **Ref** +8; **Will** +5  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 50 ft.  

**Melee** gore +16 (3d6+15)  

**Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  

**Special Attacks** stampede, trample (3d6+15, DC 25)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 31, **Dex** 12, **Con** 23, **Int** 2, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 8  

**Base Atk** +7; **CMB** +19; **CMD** 30 (34 vs. trip)  

**Feats** Alertness, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Great Fortitude, Improved Bull Rush, [Weapon Focus (gore)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Endurance is part of Toughness; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (gore).*  

**Skills** Perception +19, Sense Motive +4  

**Special Abilities**

 **Stampede (Ex)** A stampede occurs if three or more creatures with stampede make a trample attack while remaining adjacent to each other. While stampeding, the creatures can trample foes of their size or smaller, and the trample’s save DC increases by +2.
